To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the energy efficiency of the building is a factor that affects the value of residential property.
“the energy retrofit component has an appreciable influence on the housing prices, even if the energy component is not explicitly included in the Italian property valuation models”.
the energy performance of a residential building has a significant influence on its value.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following aspects: (i) the analysis of the relationship between property prices and energy performance; (ii) the development of a data-driven model that allows the estimation of property prices; (iii) the identification of the most significant factors affecting the prices of residential units.
the analysis of the influence that the energy component can have on the formation of property prices.

the following aspects: (i) it is the first study that uses a genetic algorithm for the identification of the relationship between energy efficiency and house prices, (ii) it is the second study that uses an Automated Valuation Model to analyze this relationship, (iii) it is the only study to analyze the relationship in a city of the Italian South, (iv) it provides a model that is statistically significant and interpretable.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the energy efficiency of residential units has an appreciable influence on their market value.
the energy efficiency of the building is an important component in the formation of the price of the real estate, but its importance depends on the characteristics of the building itself.
the energy component is a relevant component of the property value, even though its weight varies according to the characteristics of the property.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
energy efficiency is not yet a key factor in determining housing prices in the residential market.

the energy efficiency component has an impact on the housing market, but the effect of this impact is not yet significant enough to be considered as a determining element in the formation of the property value.
, in Italy, energy efficiency is a relevant component for housing prices, but it is not yet considered as a key factor in the decision-making processes for property transactions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the inclusion of the energy component in the automated valuation model can improve the prediction accuracy and the explanatory power of the model itself.
the energy performance component is a key element in the decision-making processes of buyers.
, even in a context of high energy efficiency, the energy performance component is still relevant for property values.
